plainText:
Crispin Freeman is an American actor and former script adaptor for the English-language dub of . He is currently affiliated with Arlene Thornton and Associates.

==Biography==
Crispin Freeman was born in , , U.S. and began his career as a voice actor in 1997. Freeman started working on as a script adaptor during the first two seasons of the show. Years later, Freeman joined the cast as a voice actor in , where he voiced Friede.
